battle.name: 意大利1848年革命
battle.brief: 一八四八年三月，米蘭民眾在五天之內逐走奧軍守備，卡洛·阿爾貝托三月返回都靈、四月頒布憲章並於四月二十三日對奧開戰；拉德茨基自維羅納北進，於四月帕斯特倫戈與聖露西亞連勝後，於七月庫斯托扎擊潰撒丁軍，米蘭再度淪陷。雷管步槍在倫巴第的村鎮攻守與山道交火中交鋒，騎槍精射改變了攻守節奏。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰方是奧地利帝國與倫巴第、威尼斯、托斯卡納、那不勒斯與教宗國等地的意大利民族軍聯盟。奧方以皇帝費迪南德一世為名義領袖，倫巴第與威尼斯的實際指揮在拉德茨基元帥手中，其下有尼格倫特與烏里希等軍長率領的分兵體系，砲兵與工兵集中於米蘭、維羅納與曼圖亞的要塞群，意大利北部的主要堡壘如佩斯基耶拉、曼圖亞、萊尼亞戈與維羅納構成四方要塞的骨架。意方在北部以撒丁王國軍隊為主體，卡洛·阿爾貝托國王兼最高指揮，下設步兵、砲兵、追擊騎兵與阿爾卑斯獵兵等縱隊，外加公民守衛隊與群眾自發武裝；在中部有波蘭革命者約瑟夫·貝姆指揮的波蘭軍團與加里波第等人組織的志願兵，在威尼斯有軍政府主持的自衛軍，在那不勒斯與教宗國則是民兵與國民警衛隊。法國二月革命後成立的臨時政府曾派出志願軍越過阿爾卑斯山與撒丁軍會師，並以加爾達尼亞的協議與撒丁停火，但規模有限，志願軍的分批抵達沒有改變倫巴第的整體局勢。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Austrian Empire and a league of national forces in Lombardy, Venice, Tuscany, Naples and the Papal States. On the Austrian side the emperor Ferdinand I was the nominal leader, while the real command in Lombardy and Venetia lay with Field Marshal Radetzky, below him corps commanders such as Nugent and Uhrich, with the artillery and the engineers concentrated in the fortresses of Milan, Verona and Mantua; the main strongholds of northern Italy, Peschiera, Mantua, Legnago and Verona, formed the framework of the quadrilateral. On the Italian side the main force in the north was the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia, commanded by the king Carlo Alberto, with infantry, artillery, cavalry and the Alpine hunters organised into separate columns, supplemented by civic guards and spontaneous bands of citizens; in the centre there was the Polish legion of the revolutionary Józef Bem and the volunteers organised by Garibaldi and others; in Venice there was the self-defence army of the republican government; and in Naples and the Papal States there were militias and national guards. The provisional government created by the February revolution in France sent volunteers across the Alps to join the Sardinian army and concluded the agreement of Gardagnola with Piedmont, but the scale was small and the volunteers arriving in batches did not change the situation in Lombardy as a whole.
people: 米蘭的五日最能說明人物的作用。卡洛·阿爾貝托起初並不想讓激進派牽著走，但米蘭在三月廿二日自發起義、逐走守備，他回到米蘭後於三月廿九日返回都靈，四月四日頒布《阿爾貝蒂諾憲章》，把王國交到國民議會與國民警衛隊手上，並於四月二十三日以義大利獨立十字軍的名義向奧地利宣戰。朱塞佩·加里波第在這一年以回國上校的身分組織阿爾卑斯獵兵，在四月的帕斯特倫戈與聖露西亞兩役中率部作戰；波蘭革命者約瑟夫·貝姆在教宗國率軍，其後成為匈牙利軍隊的指揮者。奧方除拉德茨基之外，烏里希中將在聖露西亞的失利中擔任分兵指揮，尼格倫特元帥在米蘭與後來的戰役中扮演要角；撒丁方面的拉莫里諾伯爵率領騎兵縱隊，其表現在諾瓦拉之後被追究。威尼斯的丹尼埃爾·馬寧主持軍政府，主張以國民武裝對抗奧軍並最終投向共和；朱塞佩·馬志尼以流亡者身分在歐洲各處遊說，爭取法國的軍事介入，巴黎的臨時政府在拉馬里涅推動下兩度討論出兵，但始終停在計劃與協議階段，志願兵的分批抵達沒有改變倫巴第的局勢。
peopleEn: The five days of Milan show the part played by individuals more clearly than any other episode. Carlo Alberto at first had no wish to be led by the radicals, but Milan rose of its own accord on 22 March and drove out the garrison, and after returning to Milan he left for Turin on 29 March, promulgated the Albertine Statute on 4 April, handed the kingdom to a national assembly and a civic guard, and declared war on Austria on 23 April under the banner of a crusade for Italian independence. Giuseppe Garibaldi returned in that year as a colonel, raised the Alpine hunters and fought with them in the battles of Pastrengo and Santa Lucia in April; the Polish revolutionary Józef Bem commanded in the Papal States and later became a commander of the Hungarian forces. On the Austrian side, besides Radetzky, General Uhrich led one of the detached forces defeated at Santa Lucia, and Field Marshal Nugent played a major part in Milan and in the campaigns that followed; on the Sardinian side Count Girolamo Ramorino led the cavalry columns and his conduct was called to account after Novara. Daniele Manin presided over the Venetian government, argued for meeting the Austrian army with the weapons of the citizens and moved towards a republic; Giuseppe Mazzini travelled through Europe as an exile seeking military intervention by France, and the provisional government in Paris discussed dispatch twice on Ramorino's initiative but remained at the stage of plans and agreements, and the volunteers arriving in batches did not change the situation in Lombardy.
kits: 本卡的雷管步槍在意大利的戰場上，可以看到三種同源的裝備並存。撒丁王國在一八三〇年代中期換用雷管發火，步兵配發一八四〇年代式的雷管步槍，阿爾卑斯獵兵與騎兵配雷管騎槍，騎槍手以少量啞火藥快速射擊，為的是在山道與密林裡壓制敵軍的射界；奧地利帝國步兵用一八四一年式韋恩德爾雷管步槍，並另配「弗朗茨·約瑟夫」式等步槍給狙擊與精射手，砲兵同樣使用前裝雷管炮與臼炮；威尼斯的自衛軍與各城市的國民警衛隊則多為火繩與雷管混裝，從軍械庫與民間徵收而來。米蘭五日的關鍵物資是波爾塔托薩兵工廠的庫存，起義者在三日之內把大批火槍與彈藥搬上街壘，四月二十三日卡洛·阿爾貝托回到米蘭時，第一批新編成的國民警衛隊就是用這些武器裝備的。攻城與野戰的火力差距同樣明顯：撒丁軍的野砲兵團在數目與技術上並不弱，卻缺乏攻城器材與長射程攻城砲，四月無法拿下佩斯基耶拉、曼圖亞與萊尼亞戈等堡壘；奧地利軍則靠四座要塞的存糧與牆體，把整條防線維持到一八四九年三月。
kitsEn: On the Italian front three forms of the same technology could be seen side by side. The Kingdom of Sardinia had changed to percussion in the mid 1830s: infantry were issued percussion muskets of the 1840s pattern, while the Alpine hunters and the cavalry received percussion carbines, the carbine men firing fast with small charges so as to dominate the field of fire on mountain tracks and in woods. Austrian infantry used the Werndl percussion rifle of 1841, and other percussion muskets such as the Franz Joseph pattern were issued to skirmishers and picked shots, while the artillery worked with percussion smoothbore guns and howitzers. The self-defence force of Venice and the civic guards of the towns were a mixture of flint and percussion weapons collected from arsenals and from private owners. The key material of the five days of Milan was the store of the arsenal at Porta Tosa: within three days the insurgents carried large quantities of arms and ammunition onto the barricades, and when Carlo Alberto returned to Milan on 23 April the first newly raised civic guard was equipped from those stocks. The gap in siege and field firepower was just as clear: the Sardinian field artillery was neither few nor technically poor, but siege trains and long-range siege guns were missing, and in April the fortresses of Peschiera, Mantua and Legnago could not be taken; the Austrian army, by contrast, held the whole line with the grain and the masonry of four fortresses until March 1849.
tactics: 一八四八年上半年倫巴第的戰術重點是兩件事：奪取米蘭，與用快速打擊消耗奧軍。撒丁軍的戰役多為沿著阿爾卑斯山麓與波河平原推進的縱隊作戰，步兵以營為單位，砲兵按旅分列，獵兵營在側翼山地展開，用雷管騎槍的密集快射延遲奧軍步兵接近；遇到奧軍縱隊時，卡洛·阿爾貝托常把縱隊收攏成師級密集方陣，以中央砲兵連與兩翼騎兵掩護進攻，試圖以一次會戰定勝負。奧軍的戰術同樣偏重速度與側翼：拉德茨基在帕斯特倫戈與聖露西亞兩戰都以先鋒騎兵與步兵縱隊分割敵陣，再以密集縱隊對付分散的獵兵，其撤退與再整隊的速度是義大利軍難以追上的原因。六月至七月，義軍轉入純粹的防禦戰線：聖露西亞一帶的砲台與普雷姆托拉的橋頭堡構成了抵抗的骨幹，奧軍最終以兩翼迂迴與中央突破，在庫斯托扎迫使撒丁軍放棄陣地。米蘭的市民戰術是另一套：在五天之內用巷戰、屋頂射擊與人為縱火把奧軍守備逐出城區，再用國民警衛隊接管街道與要塞，這種把城市當作要塞使用的做法，正是此後普魯士與奧地利攻取城市時的示範教材。
tacticsEn: In the first half of 1848 the tactical problem in Lombardy had two parts: to take Milan, and to wear out the Austrian army with rapid blows. The Sardinian campaigns were fought in column along the foothills of the Alps and across the plain of the Po: infantry moved by battalion, artillery was distributed by brigade, and the huntsmen deployed on the hills on the flanks, using the fast fire of percussion carbines to delay the approach of Austrian infantry. When it met an Austrian column, Carlo Alberto often drew his troops close into a division-scale mass, with a central battery group and cavalry on the wings, and tried to decide the matter in a single set-piece battle. Austrian method was likewise weighted towards speed and the flanks: at Pastrengo and Santa Lucia Radetzky used leading cavalry and infantry columns to split the enemy, and then brought massed columns against the dispersed huntsmen, and the speed with which his troops withdrew and re-formed was something the Italian army could not match. From June to July the Italians fell back into a purely defensive line: the batteries around Santa Lucia and the bridgehead at Promotora formed the backbone of the resistance, but Radetzky turned the position at Custoza with a turning movement on both wings and a breakthrough in the centre, and the Sardinian army gave up its positions. The Milanese had a different tactical logic of their own: in five days they used street fighting, fire from the roofs and deliberate burning to drive the Austrian garrison out of the city, and then handed the streets and the fortresses to the civic guard. The use of the city as a fortress, demonstrated there, became a textbook for the way Prussia and Austria afterwards took cities.
data: 可核對的時間與數字如下。米蘭起義始於一八四八年三月二十二日，二十四日市政府廣場易手，二十五日拉德茨基的援軍抵達城下，意方同意撤出，鎬·斯福爾扎城堡的守軍再抵抗數日，於四月初以體面方式投降。三月二十四日卡洛·阿爾貝托返回都靈，四月四日頒布《阿爾貝蒂諾憲章》，四月二十三日對奧地利宣戰。四月的會戰有四月六日的帕斯特倫戈與四月八日的聖露西亞，義軍兩役皆勝；五月三十日的戈伊托仍是義軍的勝利；七月二十五日庫斯托扎一役奧地利軍取勝，八月九日在維涅加萊簽訂停戰協議，倫巴第與威尼斯重歸奧地利統治，撒丁軍退出戰區並支付賠款。兵力方面，撒丁軍在倫巴第作戰的部隊合計約六萬上下，奧地利軍在倫巴第與威尼斯的總兵力約九萬上下，各方統計有出入；米蘭的奧軍守備為數千人規模，五日之後新組成的國民警衛隊同樣是數千人，武器主要來自波爾塔托薩兵工廠。威尼斯的抵抗堅持到一八四九年三月，教宗國的共和政府於一八四九年二月成立、同年七月法軍進入羅馬而崩解；一八四九年三月二十三日諾瓦拉戰役再度決定撒丁軍的敗局，卡洛·阿爾貝托隨即退位，把王位讓給維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世。
dataEn: The dates and figures that can be checked run as follows. The Milanese rising began on 22 March 1848, the piazza of the town hall changed hands on the twenty-fourth, and on the twenty-fifth Radetzky's reinforcements reached the city, the Milanese agreed to withdraw, and the garrison of the Castello Sforzesco held out for a few more days before surrendering with honours in early April. Carlo Alberto returned to Turin on 24 March, promulgated the Albertine Statute on 4 April and declared war on Austria on 23 April. The April engagements were Pastrengo on 6 April and Santa Lucia on 8 April, both won by the Italians, and Goito on 30 May was a further Italian victory; the Austrians won at Custoza on 25 July, and the armistice of Vignale was signed on 9 August, Lombardy and Venice returned to Austrian rule, and the Sardinian army withdrew from the theatre and paid an indemnity. On numbers: the Sardinian forces engaged in Lombardy came to something like sixty thousand, and the total Austrian strength in Lombardy and Venetia to something like ninety thousand, with the sources differing; the Austrian garrison of Milan was on the order of a few thousand, and the civic guard organised after the five days was of a similar order, its weapons coming chiefly from the arsenal at Porta Tosa. Venetian resistance held until March 1849; the Roman republic was proclaimed in February 1849 and collapsed in July when the French entered Rome; and the battle of Novara on 23 March 1849 settled the fate of the Sardinian army a second time, after which Carlo Alberto abdicated and handed the crown to Victor Emmanuel II.
cause: 起因是義大利在奧地利統治下的三層不滿同時爆發。第一層是政治：米蘭與威尼斯的資產者與知識分子要求由意大利人主持行政、允許新聞自由與國民議會，而奧地利自一八四五年起在倫巴第與威尼斯的警察監控與軍事佔領只會愈收愈緊。第二層是經濟：倫巴第的工業與米蘭的商業已進入歐洲前列，奧地利的關稅、壟斷性的鹽稅與多瑙河航行制度卻把它當作殖民地看待，鐵路與運河的興建也常被優先給奧地利的軍用需求。第三層是民族：加里波第與馬志尼等流亡者自一八三〇年代起就在策劃武裝起義，一八四八年三月的新聞一旦傳開，倫巴第的準備立刻轉為行動。直接引爆點是二月二十四日巴黎革命的消息，以及三月十八日維也納與柏林的革命示範：米蘭街頭的人群在二月二十二日聚集時發生衝突，隨後演成三日之內攻佔兵工廠與政府機關的起事。撒丁王國的讓步——三月二十四日回都靈、四月四日頒布憲章——把原本可能失控的城市革命接到了國家的框架裡，也讓一場民族起義得到王室的軍隊與物資。
causeEn: The cause was three layers of discontent with Austrian rule in Italy breaking out at once. The first was political: the asset owners and intellectuals of Milan and Venice wanted administration in Italian hands, freedom of the press and a national assembly, while the police surveillance and military occupation of Lombardy and Venetia, tightened from 1845 onward, were moving the other way. The second was economic: the industry of Lombardy and the commerce of Milan were already among the most advanced in Europe, yet Austrian tariffs, the state monopoly of salt and the navigation rules of the Danube treated the peninsula as a colony, and the building of railways and canals was regularly subordinated to Austrian military needs. The third was national: exiles such as Garibaldi and Mazzini had been planning an armed rising since the 1830s, and as soon as the news of March 1848 spread the preparations in Lombardy turned at once into action. The direct trigger was the news of the Paris revolution of 24 February and the example of Vienna and Berlin on 18 March: when the Milanese crowds gathered in the streets on 22 February there were clashes, which developed within three days into an rising that took the arsenal and the offices of government. The concessions of the Kingdom of Sardinia, the return to Turin on 24 March and the statute of 4 April, drew a city revolution that might otherwise have got out of hand into the framework of the state, and gave a national rising the army and the material of a monarchy.
impact: 一八四八年在意大利留下的東西，比它的勝負更持久。軍事上，撒丁軍隊第一次以全軍的姿態與奧地利帝國正面對抗，並在米蘭、倫巴第與威尼斯的城鄉戰中累積了經驗：一八四九年在諾瓦拉敗亡的同一支軍隊，一八五九年卻在同一條戰線上贏回克雷莫納與加爾富爾山口；加里波第在阿爾卑斯獵兵中建立的志願兵體制，後來成為五十與六十年代民族軍的樣板，而《阿爾貝蒂諾憲章》則把撒丁王國帶上君主立憲的軌道，並在政治上為後來的統一運動保留了合法的國體形式。政治上，一八四八年把意大利統一從少數流亡者的主張變成大眾的訴求，也讓北意與中部義大利、以及與匈牙利和德國革命連動的跨境路線成形；一八四九年二月成立的羅馬共和國、加里波第的志願兵旅以及法國的介入，把意大利問題第一次推到歐洲外交的桌面上。結果是失敗的軍事過程與成功的政治過程同時存在：一八四八年沒有解放一寸奧地利土地，卻讓統一成為下一個十年的國家大業；而威尼斯的抵抗、托斯卡納與教宗國的憲章運動，也讓意大利在政治地圖上第一次呈現出南北並存的多中心格局。
impactEn: What Italy kept from 1848 outlived the verdict of the campaigns. Militarily the Sardinian army met the Austrian Empire face to face with its whole force for the first time and gained experience in the town and country fighting of Milan, Lombardy and Venice; the same army that was destroyed at Novara in 1849 won back Cremona and the pass of Sanfèlice on that very front in 1859, and the volunteer system that Garibaldi built into the Alpine hunters became the model for the national forces of the fifties and sixties, while the Albertine Statute carried the kingdom of Sardinia onto the track of constitutional monarchy and gave the later movement for unification a legitimate form of state to work within. Politically, 1848 turned Italian unification from the programme of a few exiles into a popular demand, and it formed the cross-border lines that joined northern and central Italy with the revolutions in Hungary and Germany; the Roman republic proclaimed in February 1849, Garibaldi's volunteers and the intervention of France put the Italian question on the table of European diplomacy for the first time. The result was therefore a failed military process and a successful political process at once: not an inch of Austrian territory was liberated in 1848, but unification became the national business of the following decade, and the resistance of Venice together with the constitutional movements of Tuscany and the Papal States made Italy appear for the first time on the political map as a land with several centres in the north and the centre.
result: 一八四八年的意大利革命以一連串的失敗收場。倫巴第方面，卡洛·阿爾貝托在四月六日帕斯特倫戈與四月八日聖露西亞兩戰中取勝，把米蘭與倫巴第的主要城鎮收入，卻無法攻下佩斯基耶拉與曼圖亞；七月二十五日庫斯托扎一戰，奧地利軍以側翼迂迴與中央突破摧毀撒丁軍的方陣，卡洛·阿爾貝托退守都靈，八月九日在維涅加萊簽訂停戰協議，倫巴第與威尼斯重歸奧地利，軍隊退出戰區並支付賠款。威尼斯的抵抗堅持到一八四九年三月，教宗國的共和國只存在到同年七月。一八四九年三月二十三日諾瓦拉的戰役又給了奧地利一次決定性的勝利，迫使卡洛·阿爾貝托讓位給維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世。裝備層面的結果同樣清楚：雷管步槍與阿爾卑斯獵兵的精射足以在村鎮與山道爭奪主動，卻無法在沒有攻城砲與補給線的狀況下攻下四座要塞式堡壘；而奧地利依靠固定要塞帶來的補給優勢，顯示城市攻防中糧秣與位置比火槍精度更關鍵。
resultEn: The Italian revolution of 1848 ended in a series of defeats. In Lombardy, Carlo Alberto won at Pastrengo on 6 April and at Santa Lucia on 8 April and took Milan and the main towns of the province, but could not reduce Peschiera or Mantua; at Custoza on 25 July the Austrian army destroyed the Sardinian formation by turning its flanks and breaking its centre, Carlo Alberto fell back on Turin, and on 9 August the armistice of Vignale was signed: Lombardy and Venice returned to Austria, the army withdrew from the theatre and an indemnity was paid. The resistance of Venice held until March 1849, and the republic in the Papal States lasted only until July of that year. The battle of Novara on 23 March 1849 gave Austria a second decisive victory and forced Carlo Alberto to make way for Victor Emmanuel II. The result at the level of equipment is just as clear: the aimed fire of percussion rifles and of the Alpine carbine was enough to dispute the initiative in villages and on mountain tracks, but it could not take fortresses without siege guns and a line of supply, while the Austrian advantage in fixed fortresses with their stocks of grain showed that in the assault of towns, provisions and position matter more than the accuracy of the musket.
